items.title: Rudy Mazzari Interview, 1959-11-06
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Was anybody in Chaggy's band outstanding? [INTERVIEWEE] Well, they all were outstanding.

ctx.x: Well, yeah, I knew him while I was working at WDSU. I was a record librarian. Of course, Sharky always came in and played tapes for recordings, you know, for Capitol, wasn't it? Yeah. Yeah. Mm-hmm. So I got to hear him through that and I learned a lot about jazz, which I didn't know, you know. And, of course, being a librarian in a record library radio station is quite an experience. And I think that's how I got to learn a lot of things. And, oh, by the way, you know, one day Frank Assunto was due to make a tape…
Was anybody in Chaggy's band outstanding?
Well, they all were outstanding. I mean, to me, the whole thing was just one outstanding body.
